capture_status_at_creation: all six 0958 children and first admission sealed; no analyzer workload or capture is launched by this tool

decoder_contract.accounting: trace rows and trace-size rows must equal decoder allocation_events and requested_bytes_total

heaptrack_print_contract.folded: stack calls, with optional third requested_bytes column; calls must equal raw totals and bytes are checked when present
heaptrack_print_contract.histogram: size calls, with optional third requested_bytes column; size buckets and calls must equal decoder size aggregates

limitations.folded_bytes: The standard heaptrack_print folded export contains calls but no requested-byte column; calls are conserved and requested bytes are checked independently against raw decoder and histogram.
limitations.stage_scope: Selected rows are whole-process rows whose stack resolves the timed owner pair; they are not a phase-only allocation measurement.
limitations.tags: Source tags and intersections overlap and are descriptive; only exclusive_leaf_partition is additive.

manifest_requirements.descriptor_policy: absolute regular non-symlink files; bytes, mode and SHA-256 are checked before reading; artifact paths are unique
manifest_requirements.runs: exact six plan-v2 children in frozen order, with id, shape, workload, repeat, workers=1, warmup=0, samples=3

owner_selection.inlined_stage_surrogate: MultiSourceEdit::commit is retained as an explicitly labelled commit-core surrogate only when stage_timed_commit is inlined/unresolved; its rows are bucketed separately from exact stage_timed_commit rows
owner_selection.scope: whole-process allocation events selected by resolved timed_iteration and stage_timed_commit; stage resolution is attribution scope only and does not establish phase allocation totals
owner_selection.unknown_policy: decoder unknown_any_frame or unknown_leaf_frame keeps the row unqualified

source_tags.additivity: tags overlap and are diagnostics only
source_tags.clone_rule: Clone diagnostics use litchi_xlsx cell Number/Stored/Value/Cell clone symbols/source lines; generic allocator Box::clone rows are not promoted to source clone tags
source_tags.merge_total: selected-owner merge-tagged rows, reported separately from exclusive leaves
